claim: Do not hook an ISR-called routine that is timing-critical (such as beeper music), and keep EXX / EX AF,AF' parity even inside an ISR hook because the handler restores registers by set.

evidence.text: Title-screen ISR 63328 plays beeper music (timing-critical: never hooked).
EXX / EX AF,AF' parity must stay even (the ISR restores registers by set).
